contract.headline: CBH wins RM50.98 million solar EPC contract in Kelantan
contract.summary: CBH announced a new contract worth RM50.98 million for engineering, procurement and construction works on a 99.99-MWac solar photovoltaic project in Kelantan. Work commenced on 4 September 2026 and is scheduled for completion on 31 August 2027. The client was not named because of confidentiality provisions in the agreement.
contract.caution: Client identity was not disclosed. The Edge dateline is 18 Nov, but the article also says the company announced the news on Thursday (19 Nov).

contract.headline: Willownex bags RM28.8 million in Singapore security system contracts
contract.summary: Formerly known as Willowglen MSC Bhd, the group said its wholly owned Willowglen Services Pte Ltd secured three security and surveillance system contracts in Singapore worth a total of about RM28.8 million, all starting on 17 November 2026. Two were awarded by SP PowerAssets Ltd (RM10.45 million and RM6.83 million, both due by 16 November 2029) and one by Woh Hup Engineering Pte Ltd (RM11.97 million, due by 29 February 2028).
contract.counterparty: SP PowerAssets Ltd and Woh Hup Engineering Pte Ltd

contract.headline: LAC Med wins RM21.18 million contract to supply medical imaging equipment to three hospitals
contract.summary: Wholly owned subsidiary LAC Medical Supplies Sdn Bhd secured a RM21.18 million contract to supply, install and test angiography systems at Universiti Malaya Medical Centre, Hospital Melaka, and Hospital Raja Permaisuri Bainun in Ipoh. The group said the win lifted its outstanding order book to a record RM300 million. The three projects have 24-month contractual periods, with completion scheduled by the fourth quarter of 2028.
contract.caution: The immediate award came from an undisclosed local healthcare project partner, not directly from the hospitals.

contract.company: PMCK Bhd and Chin Hin Group Bhd
contract.headline: PMCK and Chin Hin sign binding term sheet for RM376 million Alor Setar hospital JV
contract.summary: PMCK and Chin Hin's wholly owned subsidiary Chin Hin Construction Engineering Sdn Bhd signed a binding term sheet to establish a joint venture to develop a 300-bed private hospital in Alor Setar, Kedah, at a preliminary cost of RM376 million, excluding medical equipment and loose furniture. CHCE would hold 80% and act as turnkey contractor; PMCK would hold 20% and be the exclusive operator. Construction is targeted to start in June 2027, with completion in December 2031. Separately, PMCK signed another binding term sheet with an indirect unit of Chin Hin Group Property Bhd (CHGP) to acquire a 2.78-acre lot in Melaka Tengah for RM8.48 million for another private hospital.
contract.caution: Stronger than a non-binding MoU, but still subject to regulatory approvals, final scope and contract sum, financing, and definitive agreements. The RM376 million cost is preliminary. Chin Hin Group's stock code is CHINHIN; Chin Hin Group Property's stock code is CHGP.
contract.counterparty: Chin Hin Construction Engineering Sdn Bhd / PMCK Bhd

positive.headline: CBH announces record quarterly net profit of RM34.79 million
positive.summary: Third-quarter net profit more than doubled to RM34.79 million from RM12.54 million a year earlier. Revenue for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 surged to RM228.08 million from RM31.52 million, driven by its mechanical and electrical systems business. Nine-month net profit surged to RM77.52 million from RM28.38 million, on revenue of RM438.54 million. The group also announced a RM50.98 million Kelantan solar EPC contract, listed separately in the contract section.
positive.caution: The Edge dateline is 18 Nov, but the article also says the company announced the news on Thursday (19 Nov).

positive.headline: Inari 1Q net profit rises 18.5% to RM61 million, declares 1.5 sen dividend
positive.summary: Net profit for the first quarter ended 30 September 2026 rose 18.5% to RM61 million from RM51.5 million a year earlier, with revenue up 13.1% to RM368.52 million on higher production volumes. The group declared a first interim tax-exempt dividend of 1 sen per share and a single-tier dividend of 0.5 sen per share, totalling 1.5 sen, payable on 8 January 2027.

positive.headline: Guan Chong posts record 3Q net profit of RM277.65 million, nearly seven times higher
positive.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 jumped to a record RM277.65 million from RM41.24 million a year earlier, despite revenue falling 38% to RM2.31 billion, as lower cocoa-bean costs and finance costs boosted margins. An interim dividend of 2 sen per share is payable on 18 December 2026, bringing the year-to-date total to 7.5 sen. Nine-month net profit more than tripled to RM654.25 million.

positive.headline: Kossan 3Q net profit more than doubles to RM87.41 million, declares 2.5 sen dividend
positive.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 jumped to RM87.41 million from RM37.83 million a year earlier, with revenue rising to RM671.12 million from RM438.98 million, driven by higher average selling prices and sales volumes. An interim dividend of 2.5 sen per share is payable on 18 December 2026. Nine-month net profit rose to RM191.41 million from RM104.64 million.
positive.caution: The Star headline says RM87.31 million; the article body, citing the Bursa filing, says RM87.41 million.

positive.headline: UEM Sunrise 3Q net profit more than doubles to RM48.75 million, declares 1.53 sen special dividend
positive.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 surged to RM48.75 million from RM18.49 million a year earlier, with revenue up 13.7% to RM474.88 million, helped by higher billings, stronger joint-venture earnings and lower finance costs. A special dividend of 1.53 sen per share is payable on 30 December 2026. Nine-month net profit surged 82% to RM111.8 million, while revenue grew 12% to RM1.43 billion.

positive.headline: Dutch Lady posts highest 3Q profit in 10 years, net profit up 26.3% to RM40.47 million
positive.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 jumped 26.3% to RM40.47 million from RM32.06 million, with revenue up 6.6% to RM399.26 million, driven by higher sales and foreign exchange gains. A second interim dividend of 40 sen per share is payable on 10 December 2026, bringing total dividends so far for FY2026 to 70 sen. Nine-month net profit surged 34.9% to RM108.6 million.

negative.headline: TSH 3Q net profit drops 68.5% to RM17.78 million after a RM42.5 million Indonesian fine
negative.summary: Net profit for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 fell 68.5% to RM17.78 million from RM56.41 million a year earlier, after an 84.35 billion rupiah (RM42.5 million) fine was imposed by Indonesia's Forest Area Enforcement Task Force on 90%-owned indirect subsidiary PT Sarana Prima Multi Niaga. Quarterly revenue rose 5.3% to RM277.69 million. No dividend was declared. Nine-month net profit declined 40.5% to RM91.58 million.
negative.caution: The company said core pre-tax profit excluding the fine was slightly higher, at RM89.34 million versus RM86.02 million.
